plan_summary: Authenticate to Simple Note, paginate a search for the Bucket List note, inspect matching note content, derive a checkbox-only content update for the requested item, apply it, verify the saved content, and complete the task.

steps.reasoning: Public documentation must be inspected before any task API call, so load the documentation for every API the plan will use.
steps.action_code:
api_doc_specs = (("supervisor", "show_profile"), ("supervisor", "show_account_passwords"), ("simple_note", "login"), ("simple_note", "search_notes"), ("simple_note", "show_note"), ("simple_note", "update_note"), ("supervisor", "complete_task"))
public_api_docs = {(app_name, api_name): apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=app_name, api_name=api_name) for app_name, api_name in api_doc_specs}
verification_targets: Documentation is loaded before the first task API call.

steps.reasoning: The supervisor profile supplies the account email, and the password API supplies the Simple Note credential needed to log in without exposing secrets.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
supervisor_account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
simple_note_credentials = [record for record in supervisor_account_passwords if "".join(character for character in record["account_name"].lower() if character.isalnum()) == "simplenote"]
if len(simple_note_credentials) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not uniquely resolve the Simple Note credential")
simple_note_password = simple_note_credentials[0]["password"]
simple_note_session = apis.simple_note.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=simple_note_password)
simple_note_access_token = simple_note_session["access_token"]
verification_targets: A Simple Note access token is stored without printing the password or token.

steps.reasoning: The instruction identifies the Bucket List note, so search for that title and exhaust every result page before selecting candidates.
steps.action_code:
note_search_query = "Bucket List"
all_note_summaries = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    note_page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_access_token, query=note_search_query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    all_note_summaries.extend(note_page)
    if len(note_page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
bucket_list_summaries = [note for note in all_note_summaries if note["title"].strip().casefold() == note_search_query.casefold()]
print(bucket_list_summaries)
verification_targets: Every page for the Bucket List search is read.

steps.reasoning: Search results omit note content, so fetch every exact-title candidate to locate the requested checklist item using public note data.
steps.action_code:
target_item = "Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch"
bucket_list_details = [apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=summary["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token) for summary in bucket_list_summaries]
content_candidate_summaries = [{"note_id": note["note_id"], "title": note["title"], "matching_lines": [line for line in note["content"].splitlines() if target_item in line]} for note in bucket_list_details]
print(content_candidate_summaries)
verification_targets: Detailed content is fetched for every exact-title candidate.
Candidate lines containing the requested item are exposed for review.

steps.reasoning: The fetched contents now permit a separate pre-mutation review that uniquely selects the item and derives a minimal checkbox-marker replacement while preserving all other content.
steps.action_code:
incomplete_to_done = (("[ ]", "[x]"), ("☐", "☑"), ("□", "☑"), ("⬜", "✅"))
done_markers = ("[x]", "[X]", "☑", "✅")
editable_candidates = []
already_done_candidates = []
for note in bucket_list_details:
    lines = note["content"].splitlines(keepends=True)
    for line_index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if target_item not in line:
            continue
        marker_pair = next((pair for pair in incomplete_to_done if pair[0] in line), None)
        if marker_pair is not None:
            updated_lines = list(lines)
            updated_lines[line_index] = line.replace(marker_pair[0], marker_pair[1], 1)
            editable_candidates.append({"note": note, "line_before": line, "line_after": updated_lines[line_index], "content_after": "".join(updated_lines)})
        elif any(marker in line for marker in done_markers):
            already_done_candidates.append({"note": note, "line_before": line, "line_after": line, "content_after": note["content"]})
if len(editable_candidates) == 1:
    selected_candidate = editable_candidates[0]
    needs_update = True
elif len(editable_candidates) == 0 and len(already_done_candidates) == 1:
    selected_candidate = already_done_candidates[0]
    needs_update = False
else:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not uniquely resolve the requested checklist item and state")
selected_note_id = selected_candidate["note"]["note_id"]
expected_content = selected_candidate["content_after"]
print({"note_id": selected_note_id, "title": selected_candidate["note"]["title"], "target_item": target_item, "needs_update": needs_update, "line_before": selected_candidate["line_before"], "line_after": selected_candidate["line_after"]})
verification_targets: Exactly one applicable checklist item is selected from fetched records.
The proposed content changes only its incomplete marker to a done marker.

steps.reasoning: The reviewed note ID and expected content are derived solely from prior reads, so apply the content update when the item is not already done.
steps.action_code: update_result = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=selected_note_id, access_token=simple_note_access_token, content=expected_content) if needs_update else None
verification_targets: The selected note receives the reviewed content when an update is required.

steps.reasoning: Re-read the selected public note after the mutation and compute all postconditions from its actual saved state before completing the task.
steps.action_code:
verification_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=selected_note_id, access_token=simple_note_access_token)
verification_target_lines = [line for line in verification_note["content"].splitlines() if target_item in line]
content_matches_expected = verification_note["content"] == expected_content
target_is_done = len(verification_target_lines) == 1 and any(marker in verification_target_lines[0] for marker in done_markers) and not any(marker in verification_target_lines[0] for marker, replacement in incomplete_to_done)
verification_passed = verification_note["note_id"] == selected_note_id and content_matches_expected and target_is_done
print({"note_id": verification_note["note_id"], "title": verification_note["title"], "target_item": target_item, "content_matches_expected": content_matches_expected, "target_is_done": target_is_done, "verification_passed": verification_passed})
if not verification_passed:
    raise RuntimeError("The requested done state was not verified")
verification_targets: The saved content exactly equals the reviewed expected content.
The requested item appears once with a done marker and no incomplete marker.

steps.reasoning: The postconditions have been computed and enforced from the re-read note, so the action task can now be marked successful.
verification_targets: The active action task is marked complete only after verification.
